pr_title: Add Zen mode for distraction free drawing
pr_body:
* Added Zen mode for desktop
* Added shortcut key "K" for now to test it. We can iterate over the short cut key
* Place for Icon needs to get decided

Fixes https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/1128

issue_context.title: Zen Mode
issue_context.body:
If you’re drawing a black and white scene, you almost never need to use the left menu, the zoom selector (key bindings), language selector, github corner, export... the only thing that’s useful is the list of shapes.

Would be nice to have a zen mode that hides everything so that you’re focused on drawing and not distracted.

I’m not 100% sure how the UI would look like, maybe a “full screen” icon somewhere and animating out all the elements like drawers. Ideas welcome.

Thanks to @gaearon for the idea
comments: Maybe drop the box shadow too? alternate style:
Need to check how it feels. :-)
I like the less is more version (the first one without the box shadow).. Maybe dropping it completely? (We need a designer)

This looks interesting somewhat like distraction-free mode and I was looking for something like this. Can I pick this up?

review_comments: We should also rename this to shortcutsDialogOpened, but that's for another PR

`shortcutsDialogOpened` sounds more like a user action whereas `showShortcutsDialog` sounds more like a variable that tells whether the element should hide or show on DOM. 
So  `showShortcutsDialog` looks better to me as its a state.
We can may be rename it better to `renderShortcutsDialog` | `shouldRenderShortcutsDialog` ?

`show*` suggests a transient action, so I'd go with `shortcutsDialogOpened`, too (also, it should be `shortcutsDialogOpen` without the `ed`, to be grammatically correct -- so maybe `shortcutDialogIsOpen`) -- but like @vjeux said, that's different PR.
